decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of approved permission reference 01054H/30-32/P1 dated 13/05/2016.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Received 05/01/2015:
Transport Statement by Motion (18/11/2014), Sustainability Statement by XCO2
energy (December 2014), Phase 1 Preliminary Risk Assessment by RPS (December
2014), Noise Impact Assessment by Cass Allen (26 November 2014), Energy
Statement by XCO2 energy (December 2014), Drainage Statement by GTA Civils Ltd
(December 2014), Daylight, Sunlight, Overshadowing Assessment by XCO2 energy
(December 2014), Air Quality Neutral Calculation by RPS (10 October 2014), Air
Quality Assessment by RPS (25 November 2014), Planning, Design and Access
Statement by JB Planning Associates (December 2014).
Received 13/01/2015:
P21, P22, P23
Received 17/02/2015:
140442-TK06 C, TRICS output data sheet, SAP Calculation Assumptions
(13/02/2015), SAP WorkSheet
Received 01/04/2015:
Internal Daylight & Overshadowing Assessment
by XCO2 energy (April 2015)

(PL) AE 001, (PL) AE 002, (PL) AE 003, (PL) AE 004, (PL) AE 005, (PL) AP 001, (PL) AP 002, (PL) AP 003, (PL) AP 004, (PL) AP 005, (PL) AP 006, (PL) AP 007. Received: 17th March 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a Construction Management Plan (CMP)covering the construction stages has been submitted to and approved in writing
by the Local Planning Authority. The CMP shall cover:
i. a site plan
ii. a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken and agreed with the council
iii. provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors
iv. provisions for loading and unloading of plant and materials within the site
v. provision for the storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development
vi. the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate
vii. wheel washing facilities at the site exit
viii. measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction
ix. a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
x. appropriate vehicle routes to and from the site
xi. measures to ensure the safety of all user of the public highway especially in the vicinity of the site
All construction works shall be managed in accordance with the approved CMP.

Condition : 5 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences:
b.	If required by the desk study report as approved under reference 01054H/30-32/P1(5-16) on the 25th May 2017, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
   During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 6 - The materials to be used in the external finish of the building shall be in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 01054H/30-32/P1(6) dated 11/08/2017 and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 7 - The external balconies shall be constructed in strict accordance with the details submitted and approved under application reference 01054H/30-32/P1(7) dated 02/08/2017 and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 8 - (A)	A scheme detailing site-wide hard and soft landscaping for the relevant area of the site as set out in the approved drawings shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development. 
(B)	Prior to occupation of the development the detailed landscaping scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall include the following details: soft planting: including any grass and turf areas, trees, planters, shrub and herbaceous areas including details of species, sizes and numbers/densities; hard landscaping: including ground surfaces, kerbs, edges, ridge and flexible pavings, unit paving, furniture, steps, 'visual thread' and if applicable synthetic surfaces for both ground level and roof terrace level (including finished treatment to access road); details of any play equipment (equivalent to 30sqm); fences and walls and any other boundary treatments; any signage and information boards; brown (biodiversity) roofs/green walls (where relevant); any external lighting; and any other landscaping feature(s) forming part of the scheme.
All landscaping in accordance with the approved scheme shall be completed / planted during the first planting season following completion of construction works. The submission shall include a management programme for the lifetime of the development. Any trees or shrubs planted which die within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with the same species, and of comparable maturity, or an approved alternative. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 9 - The buildings hereby approved shall not be occupied until a means of access for vehicles and pedestrians has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans and redundant accesses closed to the satisfaction of the Local Authority.

Condition : 10 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the approved drawings shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 11 - Prior to commencement of the development, details of the design and manufacture specfication of the proposed cycle storage system to accommodate a minimum of 66 cycle spaces within a horizontal arrangement shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The spaces shown on the approved drawings shall be avaialble for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 12 - Prior to commencement of development, details of secure, covered cycle storage independent from the residential cycle storage (including the siting and design) to accommodate a minimum of 8 spaces for sole use by the commerical unit shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of the commercial unit and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 13 - No unit shall be occupied until a Car Park Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include the following:
"	details and location of 20% electric vehicle charging points and details of a further 20% passive provision;
"	details of parking layout and allocations (including details as to how the occupancy will be maximised through the lease of sales)
"	details of measures proposed to restrict parking to designated bays only and prohibit parking on the access road

The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.

Condition : 14 - No unit shall be occupied until a Refuse Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall include the following:
"	Details of collection arrangements for the commercial refuse/recycling waste
"	Details of the management arrangements for the collection and storage of refuse and recycling waste within the site
The refuse storage areas and collection shall be managed in compliance with the approved Refuse Management Plan.
Condition : 15 - Each residential unit shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans..

Condition : 16 - Wheelchair accessible units shall be provided prior to first occupation of the site in line with the details submitted under application reference 01054H/30-32/P1(5-16) approved on the 25th May 2017 and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development hereby approved.

Condition : 17 - A. No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Urban Drainage Scheme, including measures as appropriate for (i) the harvesting of rainwater, (ii) the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, and (iii) the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the buildings have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  
B. The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 18 - (A) No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority that:
-	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
-	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
-	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
B. The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 19 - No part of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the London Plan policies.

Condition : 20 - The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that the development has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption of the development not exceeding 105 l/p/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Condition : 21 - (A) No development shall take place until a scheme for the storage and collection of recyclable and non-recyclable waste, including a timetable for implementation, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The approve scheme shall be accordingly managed as approved.
 
(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 22 - Details of any external plant to be installed on the relevant building(s) hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of the development. Such details shall include any necessary sound reduction strategy/mitigation measures. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 23 - A. Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from external noise, taking into consideration the recommendations of the Noise Impact Assessment by Cass Allen (26 November 2014), shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Such a scheme shall include details of measures to ensure any external balconies meet the relevant standards of BS8233. Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied.
B. Prior to any part of the development being occupied, sound insulation test reports, demonstrating compliance with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 24 - The use of the ground floor commercial space shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airbourne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given. The submission shall include post-completion testing demonstrating noise levels at the nearest residential receptors will not exceed BS 8233 (good category).

Condition : 25 - The ground floor commercial unit shall be only be used for purposes within Classes A1, A2 or A3 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2015, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 26 - The commercial floor space of the building hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 08:00 to 21:00 Monday to Saturday and 09:00 to 20:00 on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 27 - No deliveries to the ground floor commercial unit shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 08:00-19.00 Monday to Saturday, and 10.00-13.00 Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 28 - Full details of the design of the shop front to the ground floor commercial unit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the fit out of the commercial unit hereby approved. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to first occupation of the unit to which the details relate.

Condition : 29 - Any A3 use of the ground floor commercial premises shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 30 - (a) No development or demolition shall take place other that in accordance with the Written Scheme of Archaeological Investigation approved under planning reference 01054H/30-32/P1(30) dated 20/07/2017.
(b) The development shall not be occupied until the site investigation and post investigation assessment has been completed in accordance with the programme set out in the Written Scheme of Investigation approved under Part (a), and the provision for analysis, publication and dissemination of the results and archive deposition has been secured.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow various changes to the scheme approved under 01054H/30-32/P1 on 13/05/2016 for the redevelopment of the site to erect a six storey building to provide commercial uses (A1/A2 and A3 use at ground floor level) with 38 new flats above
